title: Complete the release audit follow-up fixes
objective: Close the remaining advised correctness and resource-lifecycle defects while preserving originals and honest native qualification.
context_summary: Main contains the audited first batch of fixes; the design defines the authorized follow-up and separates absent native inputs from deliverable code.

tasks.description: Implement durable catalog request identity and transactional replay, including no-ops, deletion, batches and interrupted jobs.
extra_context: Implementation authorized by the owner. Minimum model: 6.1-Sol High; Astra coordinates integration and validation. Routine engineering choices are delegated within the design.
Native hardware and private corpus inputs are late qualification requirements, not prerequisites for independent code delivery.

acceptance_criteria: Restart and cache eviction cannot replay a mutation against newer catalog work.
